I knew there'd been cheaters in Among Us prior, but I never noticed how bad it had gotten. I decided to return to this game after a long time of not playing it, and out of 5 matches, 3 of them included blatant cheaters instant killing everyone around the table, constantly setting off multiple sabotages, as well as naming the imposters and exactly what their roles were.

I rarely leave reviews, and when I do, it's usually a silly Recommended review, but holy wow. I would not recommend anyone play this game until Innersloth does something about this.
